# Independent hosted Linux confirmation

This is a new prospective experiment, with independent openings and separate evidence. The original hosted-strength package, trigger branch, failed pilot and raw records remain unchanged. Preparation and mocked safety tests do not establish chess strength or host readiness.

Frozen sources are Forge6.4.7 `2c0c7efa49023d8e3f49de3f5596f333a3f01202` against Forge6.4.4 `816423b1ddac23a00244449deef59dba736055a9`; this does not test6.4.8/6.4.9. Both builds use GCC14, identical generic x86-64-v3 Release flags and full CTest before timing. Actual built executables, core archives and pinned Fastchess60d7a7a bytes are archived before timing; matches execute those archived binaries. Source export hashes, compiler commands, test logs, original PGNs/console/state and every final input hash are retained.

The protocol first requires the original gross-instability benchmark A/A gate (2excluded warmups,3baseline/baseline bench11pairs,419798nodes each; CPU and external-wall median ratios0.95..1.05 and all0.85..1.15), then4complete deterministic fixed10000node color-swapped A/A readiness pairs. Neither calibration supplies Elo evidence. A failed gate stops this attempt without retry.

The new strength test is serial native logistic SPRT H0=0/H1=10 Elo, alpha=beta=.05, one thread, Hash32,2+0.02, overhead10, OwnBook=false, Ponder=false advertised default, restart per game. The independent wrapper recomputes the0/+10 likelihood, requires final finite native LLR and exactly one native decision for a decided match, and audits complete normal pairs, native pentanomial counts and exact opening prefix. Its frozen CLI is a copy of the repository CLI changing the design alternative from5to10 and enabling engine communication logging; it keeps smoke-only maxmoves200 for readiness, with no strength move cap or score adjudication.

Natural stopping is a native boundary or160complete pairs/320games. There is no48-pair screen, continuation, resume, reset, trimming or pooling with the earlier run. The48minute SPRT wall guard is an emergency failure limit, not a successful stopping rule; any intervention, incomplete pair, changed input, non-normal termination or warning/error forbids acceptance and preserves all records. The wrapper performs final input rehash even after signals, faults and deadlines. The job has58minutes, with52minutes for calibration/play/audit and4minutes for builds. An emergency or platform cancellation remains possible; hard runner loss can prevent final cleanup, so preserved evidence is best effort under platform loss.

The164selected positions are original corpus rows already carrying EP='-', with4AA and160SPRT positions. All discovered historical selections and the entire prior504position hosted pool, including unused positions, are excluded before the new seed ranking. Selection uses no engine evaluation. The synthetic quiet-development corpus is not a representative human opening distribution. Runtime order is independently frozen in provenance/runtime-order.json.

The newly found OwnBook/custom Book File override is a separate source issue. Independent source review confirmed that both frozen647/644 initialize book_file empty and that the override requires !book_file.empty(). This protocol sends OwnBook=false and no Book File option, and requires the advertised empty default at runtime; the separate bug is unreachable under these options. Neither frozen source changes.

The workflow triggers only a push to forge/hosted-confirmation-20261019-* and only attempt1. Results use results/hosted-confirmation-RUNID-ATTEMPT, which cannot retrigger the workflow. Artifact upload and fresh results-branch preservation use always(). Root independently reviewed source/options, openings, ownership cleanup, logging and acceptance gates; the protocol is now PREREGISTERED_REVIEWED_READY_FOR_SINGLE_PUSH. There are no retries or authentication/infrastructure fallbacks.

A clean H1 concerns only these frozen sources, opponent, hosted Linux resources and2+0.02 control; it does not prove a gain of at least10Elo. A finite-cap run without a boundary is inconclusive. No Windows/Ryzen, Stockfish or later-candidate strength claim follows.

Pinned Fastchess logging uses level=warn and engine=true: every engine communication is retained independently of warning level. Both sides incur the same frozen logging I/O overhead, so any accepted result includes that overhead. The live scanner reads newly appended bytes plus an incomplete previous line; it preserves split warning/termination detection and rejects observed output truncation, replacement or deletion. Final audits read each full raw file once.
